text:
No option can be put forward from this run, because the **annual salary spend < £400k/year** limit was not checked.

- All four options lacked a stated effect on annual salary spend, so the run treated each as leaving it unchanged; that makes the budget comparison uninformative.
- The delivery comparison is also fragile and rests entirely on Olumi-authored estimates, including delivery capacity and onboarding load. The intended direction of the delivery goal was not explicitly stated either.
- The model needs comparable annual salary-spend levels for each staffing option, expressed in the same frame as the £400k/year limit, before it can test the central trade-off.
